description.p: Tsumige keeps your visual novel library in one place and launches each game with the runner you choose: Proton, Wine, native, or Steam. Covers, descriptions and tags come from VNDB, and everything stays on your computer.
Point Tsumige at a folder of games or import your installed Steam games, check every VNDB match, and play. Your library is a JSON file in your data folder: no account, no server.

ul.li: Folder and Steam import with VNDB matching you review first
Episode groups that keep chapters and volumes of one game on a shared tile
Your own titles, developers and release dates, kept when VNDB data refreshes
SteamGridDB covers and backgrounds with your own free API key
Per-game runners: Proton through umu-run, Wine, native and Steam
Playtime recorded for every session, with per-game totals and history
